title: Desktop boot: bottle asset() TypeError traceback (pywebview /route bug)
resolution: webview/http.py asset(file) also bound to @app.route('/') with no file arg. bottle 0.13.4 + pywebview 6.2.1. exe console=False so stderr invisible to users. Harmless.

title: CODEX_HANDOFF.md/known-limitations undersold shipped features (honesty)
resolution: Listed KodroBench, CLI, URDF I/O as absent though shipped (kodrobench.py, pyproject scripts, interop/urdf_io.py). i18n said 'partial' but absent. Corrected §9 to verified state.

title: CI red: parallel-session work landed on main unformatted + violating offline guard
resolution: eb03c8c/36ab0b8 CI failed 3/3 OS. (1) Ruff format: app.py export_urdf/_drain_scale_for signatures wrapped narrower than ruff wants (36ab0b8). (2) Pytest test_no_network_apis_in_app_code: parts-db.js cites www.pololu.com, a genuine gate conflict since qa_parts.mjs:36 REQUIRES that source to be an https:// URL. Was masked by the earlier ruff failure. The 'ff main / push both' step had also been skipped during the parallel session, so origin/main sat stale at 541941d and the live deploy missed all parallel work.

title: Offline-guard vs parts-citation gate conflict (root fix, not suppression)
resolution: parts-db.js is a pure data module (no fetch/.src anywhere, grep-verified). Gave it a file-scoped citation-host exemption in test_web_offline.py mirroring the BYOK and w3.org/spdx.org exemptions, plus a compensating assertion that the module stays fetch-free so the cited host provably can't become a network target. Guard stays strict for every other file. c93005b.

title: interop/__init__.py left untracked (incomplete package commit)
resolution: A prior change committed src/robolearn/interop/urdf_io.py but never git-added the package __init__.py (present on disk, so local worked). CI stayed green because Python implicit namespace packages resolve robolearn.interop.urdf_io without it (web/app.py:33 + test_urdf_export.py import that path), but the documented public API (from robolearn.interop import export_urdf, ...) and the package docstring were absent on any clean checkout, and packaging could drop the subpackage. Tracked the init (2ea3b4f); it already executes locally and its re-exports resolve.

title: In-browser pupil records store (web Teacher Dashboard is dead empty-state)
resolution: SHIPPED: pupil-store.js (new module) keeps an on-device localStorage class register with the SAME concept-strength EMA (alpha=0.3) as the desktop store.py, so mastery matches on both surfaces. Wired: app.jsx gradeWithBridge records every graded attempt (pass+fail) against the lesson's concepts in browser mode only; bridge.getClassHeatmap browser path now returns the store heatmap; hooks.useTeacher dropped its 'desktop only' short-circuit; panels TeacherModal renders the real heatmap table (browser copy: saved in this browser on this device). Gates: qa_pupilstore.mjs 23/0 (EMA 1.0->0.7->0.49 pa

title: Run replay + seed/event enrichment
resolution: FIXED: every live run is seeded (mulberry32, same generator as scenario.jsx); host.rng feeds random(); run reports persist seed + program source (runreport.js); Replay button re-drives world+program+seed deterministically (app.jsx replayRun). Gates: qa_interpreter SEEDED RNG cases + qa_ui checkReplay (two replays of a random()-dependent program byte-identical). DISCLOSED LIMIT: the min-proximity readout is a per-frame sensor sample, so an identical replayed trajectory can log it on one run and miss it on the other; the gate therefore asserts distance+battery+outcome exactly and excludes the sa

title: Gymnasium KodroEnv-v0 over bench.py
resolution: FIXED: gymnasium KodroEnv-v0 (src/robolearn/envs/kodro_env.py) wrapping the real bench/engine machinery (seeded _world_for_seed, Rover.move/turn, lidar_distance). Discrete(4) actions, Box(5) obs, deterministic reset(seed). pyproject extra rl=[gymnasium>=1.0]. Gate: tests/unit/test_kodro_env.py 8 tests incl. measured golden returns 3.25 / -10.35494935654426; importorskip so CI without gymnasium skips clean.

title: Full sensor command bindings (line-follower first)
resolution: FIXED: on_line() bound like distance(): SENSOR_METHODS + lesson alias (interpreter.js), COMMAND_PART line gating with readable refusal (RobotLab.jsx), synthesized straight practice line |y|<=20cm in the live host (hooks.jsx), fidelity disclosure updated (specschema.js notSimulated names the synthetic line). Gate: qa_interpreter LINE FOLLOWER 6 cases (binding, branching, refusal).

title: URDF -> KRS import into the web Lab
resolution: FIXED: krs_from_urdf() in interop/urdf_io.py emits only URDF-supported fields (massKg, wheelRadiusCm, motorCount, differential, wheelbase when unambiguous) + declared[] notes for what URDF cannot provide; NEVER invents motor/battery numbers. app.py import_robot_spec accepts *.urdf via _urdf_spec_payload with the same {ok,text,name} shape. Motorless physical blocks validate ok (verified against real specschema.js). Gate: tests/unit/test_urdf_import.py 7 tests, golden fixture 1.5kg/3cm wheels/15cm wheelbase.

title: World/mission authoring: data schema + minimal creator
resolution: FIXED: runtime custom world (terrains.jsx customWorld): seed + density(sparse5/normal10/dense18) + traction(0.3..1.2), Earth-based so both renderers work, URL params kseed/kdensity/ktraction as shareable initial state, NO persistence v1. Settings rows drive it live (kodro-customworld tick regenerates in place). Gate: qa_ui checkCustomWorld (sparse vs dense obstacle counts via data-obstacles stamp).

title: Bounded AI tool/function-calling loop
resolution: FIXED: bounded grammar-constrained tool call (ai-web.jsx toolCall): ONE whitelisted tool (set_world), format-schema enum forces the shape, resolveToolCall validates args against live TERRAINS+SITES ids; invalid = readable refusal, model failure = silent fallback to the deterministic intent parse; wired into vibeSend AFTER the parse. Gate: qa_ai_web BOUNDED TOOL CALL 8 cases (apply, refuse, none, malformed, non-whitelisted).

title: RobotSpec v0->v1 migration step
resolution: FIXED: explicit migrateSpec(raw, fromV1) in RobotLab.jsx replaces the silent load fallback: sensor floor preserved verbatim, kodroSpec:1 stamp, migrationNotes recorded on the spec; exposed on KodroCommands for headless testing. Gate: qa_interpreter SPEC MIGRATION 8 cases incl. round-trip through the real KRS validator.

title: Browser interpreter: no allocation cap on repeat/concat (tab OOM)
resolution: interpreter.js binop capSeqLen(MAX_SEQ_LEN=1e6) on string/list * and +; 'x'*5e6 and s=s+s doubling now throw RoverError. qa_interpreter cases added.

title: Browser interpreter: list*int silently coerced (parity)
resolution: binop('*') now handles Array x int both orders; [0]*3->[0,0,0], [1,2]*2->[1,2,1,2], 3*[7]->[7,7,7]. Matches Python grader. qa_interpreter 163.

title: README telemetry 'samples collected' false claim
resolution: Telemetry.jsx has no samples readout; README bullet changed to 'traction'.

title: Python 'hard timeout' not hard vs GIL-holding bignum; over-budget graded SUCCESS
resolution: sandbox.py rejects constant-foldable ** exponent > MAX_POW_EXP=4096 (short-circuit fold, no bignum materialised). execute('10**10**7') now error_kind=sandbox in 0.00s (was 8.1s SUCCESS). 2**2**3=256 allowed. 8 sandbox tests.

title: Lesson 10 vacuous criterion 'Travel at least 0 m'
resolution: Removed min_distance_travelled:0.0 from 10_optimisation.yaml + JS LESSON_DATA mirror (always-true no-op that rendered a nonsense goal). Lesson keeps samples+return+battery. grader QA 34.

title: TweaksPanel renders but never shows (design-tool scaffold)
resolution: FIXED: Scene tweaks Settings row posts the __activate_edit_mode handshake, so the camera/scene/trail tweaks panel is reachable for real instead of dead UI behind a host handshake nothing sent. Gate: qa_ui checkTweaksPanel.

title: Robot Lab footer pushed the primary Build & test CTA off-screen at all desktop widths
resolution: FIXED: .rl-foot flex-wrap at every width (styles.css), not only <=640px. Gate: judge screenshot round 2.

title: Endurance minutes read as fact and confused two battery axes (time vs distance)
resolution: FIXED: diagnostics endurance copy now says rough estimate and states the sim tracks battery by distance, not the clock.

title: Catalogue top speed badged HONOURED in the Lab while the report tiers it APPROXIMATED
resolution: FIXED: RobotLab catalogue top-speed badge defaults to approximated; value shown as x-factor not a bare number. qa_honesty.mjs pins it.

title: Settings popover rendered off the left edge, clipping every row label
resolution: FIXED: .settings-pop anchored left:0 (was right:0). Gate: judge screenshot round 2.

title: Learning half invisible: no in-product signpost that Classroom/18 lessons exist
resolution: FIXED: a Lessons button in the top bar switches to classroom + reveals the lesson picker in one click. qa_ui checkLessonsEntry.

title: Classroom lesson picker crushed the example tab strip to ~18px
resolution: FIXED: .tabs min-width:120px floor + flex-basis, strip scrolls instead of collapsing.

title: Onboarding dialog aria-modal but no focus containment; 49 studio controls tabbable behind it
resolution: FIXED: onboarding keydown traps Tab within .konb-root, Escape still closes.

title: The only Revert for a programmatic code overwrite auto-removed after 7s
resolution: FIXED: action toasts persist until clicked (button self-dismisses) or superseded by the next; only non-action toasts time out.

title: Boot backstop falsely declared 'failed to load' after a fixed 4s on slow devices

title: First-run quality floor was med, so the Low tier was unreachable on 2GB/2-core devices
resolution: FIXED: picker returns low when deviceMemory<=2 or cores<=2.

title: Budget planner showed AI-generated part prices as flat facts, exempt from the honesty discipline
resolution: FIXED: prices prefixed ~ and a note says they are rough AI estimates, not live quotes. qa_honesty.mjs pins the note.

title: On a 420px phone the world was a 142px letterbox below two screens of code; first Run showed nothing
resolution: FIXED: mobile CSS orders .view-panel first at 46vh so the living city is the first thing a phone shows.

title: Realism headline showed 'Top speed 1.25x', a unitless multiplier, on the honest-numbers surface
resolution: FIXED: realism shows measured m/s when available, else an explicitly-labelled relative factor.

title: Two stopping distances for one build: 130cm design check (proxy) vs 113cm report (physics)
resolution: FIXED: diagnostics catalogue stop now uses the SAME physStoppingDistanceCm on baseSpeed*speedFactor as the report. qa_honesty.mjs pins parity.

title: Design check promised the run would 'perform cleanly' then the starter crashed in the city
resolution: FIXED: reworded to judge the build ('This build suits X. Press Run to see how your program drives it'), not the program.

title: APPROXIMATED tooltip and report promised 'honest error bars' but no uncertainty range exists
resolution: FIXED: replaced with 'a first-order estimate, real hardware will differ'; qa_honesty.mjs bans the phrase in shipped source.

title: Brand strapline wrapped one word per line and clipped mid-glyph at 420px
resolution: FIXED: .brand-sub hidden under the phone media query.

title: Run-compare checkboxes had identical accessible names for different runs
resolution: FIXED: aria-label now includes each run's timestamp.

title: Default first Run in the flagship city crashed into a parked car; the starter's promised report never printed
resolution: FIXED: the shipped starter (app-data.jsx drive tab) is now a sense-and-avoid explore demo (distance()<130 steers, move 100<130 so a step can never carry it into a sensed obstacle). Verified deterministic: city 8-9m clean, no HALTED, report prints; earth 14m. Showcases the product's core value (sense before you build). Gate: qa_ui checkFirstRunClean (default city run, no HALTED + report + odo>=floor). Dissertation Appendix B updated to the sensing first-example.

title: The NOT SIMULATED fidelity badge (the strongest honesty claim) failed AA contrast at 3.31:1
resolution: FIXED: badge text switched to dark --void on a lighter mars #d98a7e (7.38:1, passes AA), font bumped 9->10px to match the other tiers. realism.jsx.

title: Inactive editor tabs illegible (1.96:1) and active/inactive emphasis inverted: the .tab button fell back to the UA light button face
resolution: FIXED: .tab base rule now sets appearance:none + background:transparent (so it sits on the dark tab bar, not the UA light face) and color:var(--fg-2) (8.8:1 on --navy, was --fg-3 at 3.99:1). Active tab stays cyan-on-void with a border, so emphasis is correct. NEW qa_contrast.mjs pins tab-label AA across all 10 themes.

title: Pixel classroom theme Reset label failed AA (2.96:1); the gate then also caught the lego theme (4.28:1)
resolution: FIXED: pixel --danger #b13e53 -> #ffa3b0 (5.44:1 on the pixel mission bar); lego --danger #d01012 -> #b3141f (5.31:1 on the lego yellow bar). NEW qa_contrast.mjs computes --danger-on-mission-bar AA for EVERY theme, wired into CI.

title: Browser teacher register said 'How the class is doing / Pupil' but tracks one record per device, with no disclosure of that limit
resolution: FIXED: in browser mode the modal eyebrow reads 'Progress on this device, idea by idea', the table header is 'Learner' not 'Pupil', and the note discloses 'Kodro keeps one record per device, so everyone using this device counts together; open the desktop app to keep a separate record for each pupil.' No behaviour change, honest framing. qa_ui checkPupilRecords still green.

title: Mobile: the 3D/2D/quality/time/weather view controls clipped off-screen at phone width with no scroll; the 3D toggle was a 14px sliver (WCAG 2.5.5 fail)
resolution: FIXED: at <=640px the .view-toggle takes a full-width row inside .terrain-switch with overflow-x:auto (a horizontal-scroll strip like the world buttons), so the 3D/2D toggles are fully visible at the start and every control is reachable. Verified at 375px: 3D/2D/LOW/NOON/CLEAR all visible. NEW qa_contrast.mjs responsive assertion pins the rule.

title: Default-theme telemetry/section labels (--fg-3) failed AA at 3.99:1
resolution: FIXED: default --fg-3 alpha 0.44 -> 0.55 (5.4-5.6:1 on void/navy/navy-2). qa_contrast.mjs now asserts --fg-3 on --void >= 4.5 across ALL 10 themes (33/33).

title: Editor highlight overlay (.code-pre) + line-number gutter were not aria-hidden, so screen readers read the program 2-3x
resolution: FIXED: aria-hidden=true on .code-pre and .gutter in Editor.jsx; the labelled .code-ta textarea is the sole accessible editor content.

title: Verification report 'Measured evidence' mean speed was inflated by the cosmetic sim-speed slider: a 3x slider showed a 3x-too-fast measured m/s, undermining the product's core 'would your robot actually work' claim
resolution: FIXED: verify.jsx computed measuredMps = (distanceCm/100)/(wallMs/1000), but animation durations are divided by speedMul (a cosmetic playback slider), so wallMs was compressed by the slider and the 'measured' speed scaled with it. Now normalises the slider back out: trueMs = wallMs * (speedMul||1); measuredMps = (distanceCm/100)/(trueMs/1000); seconds = round(trueMs/100)/10. The measured evidence is now slider-invariant. NEW qa_honesty.mjs asserts verify multiplies wall time by speedMul and no longer divides by the raw wallMs (now 25 checks).

title: Mobile: at phone width the mission bar hid the primary nav icons (Lessons, Robot Lab, Memory, Build, Settings) behind a scrollbar-less horizontal scroll, so they were unreachable
resolution: FIXED: the @media(max-width:768px) .missionbar rule was flex-wrap:nowrap + overflow-x:auto + scrollbar-width:none, which clipped the nav icons off-screen with no visible scrollbar. Now .app grid-template-rows:auto 1fr and .missionbar flex-wrap:wrap; height:auto; min-height:48px; overflow:visible, so the bar wraps and every control stays on screen. Verified at 375px: Run/Step/Reset/Validate + all 6 nav icons (Lessons/Robot Lab/Memory/Build/Help/Settings) render, none clipped. NEW qa_contrast.mjs asserts the bar wraps (not nowrap-scroll) at phone width.

title: Studio panel and modal titles were plain .eyebrow spans, not headings, so screen-reader heading navigation could not jump between the studio's sections
resolution: FIXED: the 18 .eyebrow TITLE spans across Telemetry.jsx (4), app.jsx (3) and panels.jsx (11) now carry role="heading" aria-level="2"; sub-label .eyebrow DIVs (non-titles) were left untouched. Confirmed 6 role=heading nodes render in the studio DOM. NEW qa_contrast.mjs asserts >=15 eyebrow title spans are level-2 headings.

resolution: FIXED (two-part root fix): (a) specschema.js FIDELITY.notSimulated now discloses 'Water, buoyancy, depth pressure and vacuum: the underwater and space sites change gravity, traction and light only, so a run there proves driving, sensing and battery on that surface, never that the build survives the water, the depth pressure or the vacuum itself' - rendered by the Realism dashboard, RobotLab badges and the exported report annex. (b) diagnostics.jsx assess() now stamps numbers.unsimHazard from terrain.env.pressureLabel (DEPTH -> 'water and depth pressure', VACUUM -> 'vacuum and space temperature

resolution: FIXED (root + deeper): .app grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) lets the studio shrink to the real viewport; phone panels get min-width:0!important so the editor's max-content code layer scrolls INSIDE .editor-wrap instead of pushing the page; the .run-controls group (Run/Step/Reset/Validate, ~364px nowrap) now flex-wraps at phone width; mission-site select capped. Verified at TRUE 320/375/420px viewports (body scrollWidth == innerWidth, 0px clipped) via a new CDP device-emulation probe (scripts/lib/cdp-viewport.mjs) - NOT --window-size, which headless Chrome clamps to ~482px and so tested the

title: On phone-height screens tapping Lessons produced a broken whole-page reflow (docW 437->1908px): the classroom-only nowrap .api-hint strip inflated min-content; the lesson picker also rendered below the fold with no feedback
resolution: FIXED: .api-hint min-width:0 + max-width:100% (scrolls in place, cannot inflate layout); classroom mode now scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) the lesson picker on open (no-op on desktop). NEW qa_ui layout-classroom-420 gate.

title: Endurance/range figures contradicted the sim's own enforced battery ledger ~150x (87 min / 20.39 km displayed vs ~128 m enforced)
resolution: FIXED at the root: new shared helpers catRangeCm/catEnduranceMin in motion-model.js (+ Python mirror cat_range_cm/cat_endurance_min) derive endurance FROM the enforced distance ledger. RobotLab stat shows the ledger range; the verification report's catalogue Runtime/Range rows derive from the ledger; the design-check Endurance dimension is range-based (fail <30 m, warn <80 m); the battery-flat verdict quotes metres; realism shows the ledger range. Physical builds keep their real pack figures. qa_honesty: 8 new checks incl. vm-run of the real assess (default city build ~127 m).

title: tilt() fabricated non-zero slope readings (+/-11 deg position-seeded sine) on flat worlds, contradicting the fidelity disclosure and diverging from the self-test/lesson-grader/Python engines
resolution: FIXED: hooks.jsx and scenario.jsx tilt() now return 0 (matching the disclosure 'returns level readings' and every other engine). qa_honesty pins both files.

title: Slope-named sites (Mount Fuji Slopes, Himalayan Foothills) gave the unqualified 'design held up' verdict though slopes are not simulated (they inherit earth's env so the JR8-01 pressure detection missed them); P3 duplicate about slope untestability covered here
resolution: FIXED: sites can declare unsim:'slopes and terrain height'; the merge propagates terrain.unsimHazard; diagnostics prefers the explicit field over the pressure-label fallback, so Fuji/Nepal clean runs are scoped like underwater/space. qa_honesty vm-runs a Fuji-like terrain.

title: Browser 'Export progress report' silently dead-ended (popover closed, console-only feedback)
resolution: FIXED: the browser path now builds the real progress report from the pupil store (same picture as the teacher register), downloads it as kodro-progress-report.txt, and toasts visibly; failures toast too. qa_honesty source-asserts the Blob download + toast.

title: World-switch and 2D/3D labels failed WCAG AA (3.37-3.45:1) on bright scenes: --hud-fg-3 at 0.54 alpha on 0.7-alpha glass; the 2D/3D pill even used the theme --fg-3 token that flips dark in light themes
resolution: FIXED: --hud-fg-3 0.54->0.78, --hud-fg-2 0.74->0.88 (hierarchy kept), all four text-bearing HUD glasses (terrain-switch, view-mode-pill, orbit-hint, hud-bl) darkened to >=0.8 alpha, and the pill now uses the HUD token. Worst-case composite (glass over WHITE sky) is now >=6:1. NEW qa_contrast composite-over-white checks.

title: During any run the whole App tree re-rendered ~60Hz while mapping an uncapped, session-persistent console array and re-tokenizing the editor every frame
resolution: FIXED (the two heavy per-frame costs): Editor highlight memoized on [code]; console buffer capped at 1000 lines and the render maps only the last 300 (with an elision note). The 60Hz App-root state sync itself remains by design (live telemetry) and is now cheap; recorded honestly as mitigated, not eliminated. qa_contrast pins all three. ALSO: this fix round exposed a qa_web gate hole (a broken studio component passed because 'Skip to studio' renders in onboarding) - qa_web now has a studio-mount check that drives cap.html?world=city and fails on any real console error (5 checks). Building this

title: Learning pillar invisible at first contact: onboarding never mentioned lessons and the only entry was an unlabeled icon below 1360px
resolution: FIXED: onboarding step 3 introduces Lessons (18 graded missions, ages 5 up, where to find them); the Lessons button keeps its visible text label at EVERY width (.icon-btn-lessons exempt from label hiding). qa_honesty + qa_contrast pin both.

title: Rich run-report rows pushed the Replay button and timestamp off-screen as an invisible sliver at the default editor width
resolution: FIXED: .run-entry wraps (flex-wrap:wrap), so every control stays on screen at any panel width. qa_contrast pins the rule.

title: Teacher register marked the active row with a bare middot (same glyph as 'not attempted' cells) and no legend
resolution: FIXED: active row now reads '(active)' in words; the note explains the not-attempted dot. qa_contrast pins it.

title: Compare checkboxes gave identical accessible names for same-robot same-minute runs; browser Build modal called separately-installed Ollama 'the built-in local AI'
resolution: FIXED: compare aria-labels now carry outcome + world + seconds (unique); Build modal copy names Ollama as a separate free install and says the planner cannot run without it. Gates in qa_contrast + qa_honesty.

title: Runtime quality step-down was silent for the quality-gated ambient/weather systems, which kept running at the old tier
resolution: FIXED: the step-down now publishes window.KODRO_QUALITY='low' (ambient reads it live each frame) and disposes the weather particle system (rain/snow gained dispose()). qa_contrast pins the propagation.

title: Weather presets change light/visuals only but were absent from the fidelity disclosure; realism dashboard claimed 'Sensor noise: nominal' though live runs are noise-free
resolution: FIXED: FIDELITY.notSimulated gains the weather line; realism now says 'none in live runs (injected only during multi-seed validation)'. Design-check stopping-distance texts also now carry their 'approximated' tier tag (was quoted untiered). qa_honesty pins all three.

title: Code comments — the primary teaching text — rendered at ~1.8:1 contrast (.tok-com used --fg-4 0.22a on --void); gutter line numbers + REPL placeholder same; 'readable text' setting only resized, never recoloured them
resolution: FIXED: .tok-com, the gutter and .repl-input::placeholder switched from --fg-4 to --fg-3 (0.55a), which qa_contrast §3b already verifies clears WCAG AA on --void in all 10 themes, while staying dimmer than the code. Verified 20 tok-com spans render. qa_honesty §17 pins the token.

title: Blocks palette offered 'collect sample'/'drop sample' as always-enabled action blocks on the free Studio surface, but they are print-only stubs there (the studio command hint strip already delisted them); only real when a lesson supplies the sample mechanic
resolution: FIXED: collect/drop marked lessonOnly in app-data.jsx; BlocksModal filters lessonOnly blocks out of the palette unless classroom mode (app.jsx passes classroom). Verified: absent in Studio, present in Classroom. qa_honesty §19 pins it.

title: Mars run returned an unqualified 'design held up' while showing 0.006 atm (near-vacuum) + -63C and simulating only gravity+traction; Mars escaped the JR8/JR9 verdict-scoping because it was labelled 'PRESSURE' not a vacuum-class label
resolution: FIXED (data-driven, covers the class): diagnostics computes a thin-atmosphere hazard when pressureLabel='PRESSURE' + unit 'atm' + pressure<0.5, so Mars (0.006) scopes its verdict ('...thin, near-vacuum atmosphere and its temperature extremes are not simulated, so this run cannot prove the build survives them') while normal 1-atm worlds keep the plain verdict. Temperature alone is NOT a trigger (per the refuter, to avoid over-flagging Antarctica/Nepal). Verified live on Mars. qa_honesty §18 pins both branches.

title: Catalogue 'no-load top speed' scaled with drive-part count/type (4 DC motors=1.25x, servo=1.1x), which is physically wrong (no-load top speed is kinematic: wheel rpm x circumference, count-independent) and contradicts Kodro's own measured path (rpm+radius only) and the motors4 'more grip and torque' note
resolution: FIXED: all catalogue drive/actuator speed tiers set to one shared nominal 1.0; the motor-count advantage now surfaces only in Mobility/endurance (torque+grip), never top speed. motors4 note clarifies 'more grip and torque (not more top speed)'. Catalogue top-speed DISPLAY changed from a per-build 'x1.00' multiplier to honest words ('standard'/'standard (no-load); import a measured spec for a per-build figure') in RobotLab + realism; measured (KRS-import) builds still show real m/s. Interpreter 180 / grader 34 / physics 20 unaffected (odometer is program-driven, speed-independent). qa_honesty §

title: Robot Lab badge + Realism dashboard showed ~131 m 'range on one charge' (computed at a hardcoded reference traction 1.0) while the design-check Endurance line showed ~129 m (world traction 0.98); Realism captioned the wrong (131) figure '(the ledger the run enforces)'. Same-ledger inconsistency I introduced in JR9-03
resolution: FIXED: the Robot Lab range badge now reuses the design-check's world-accurate report.numbers.rangeM (identical source as the Endurance line on the same screen), and the Realism Battery row recomputes catRangeCm at the current world's traction so its '(the ledger the run enforces)' caption is true. Measured (KRS-import) builds keep their nominal per-pack figure. Verified live in Riverside City: badge=129, Endurance=129, Realism=129 'here'. qa_honesty §20 pins all three surfaces + a behavioural check that the world-traction figure is below the nominal traction-1 figure and equals the design-chec

title: Teacher register heatmap table had no row/column header semantics (WCAG 1.3.1): the learner name was a <td>, and the <thead> <th> cells carried no scope, so a screen-reader teacher navigating a multi-pupil register loses per-cell learner context
resolution: FIXED: the learner name is now <th scope="row" class="hm-name">, the concept columns and the corner cell are <th scope="col">; a CSS override keeps the row-header left-aligned, body-weight and non-sticky. Verified live: seeded register renders <th scope=row>This device</th> + 3 scope=col headers. qa_honesty §21 pins the markup.

title: Robot Lab 'Fit a motor' quick-fit silently injected a 3.5 cm wheel radius, then rendered a 2-decimal top speed with a HONOURED badge under a 'Measured build' banner - for a build with no real wheel. No-load top speed is linear in wheel radius (stopping distance quadratic), so the headline figure swings ~2x/~4x with the real wheel. Contradicted the app's own import path, which REFUSES top speed without a wheelRadiusCm
resolution: FIXED: applyMotor now flags the injected radius (drive.wheelRadiusAssumed=true) and its toast discloses the assumption; deriveFromPhysical caps an assumed-wheel top speed at APPROXIMATED (never honoured, however cleanly it simulates) and pushes a warning 'Top speed assumes a 3.5 cm wheel radius...'; the derived block exposes wheelRadiusCm + wheelRadiusAssumed and the Robot Lab measured banner shows a 'Wheel 3.5 cm (assumed)' row with the approximated badge. A REAL imported wheel radius still honours the top speed (regression-guarded). qa_honesty §22 pins the behaviour (assumed->approximated+wa

title: WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name (Level A): the sim-speed slider showed visible label 'Sim speed' but had aria-label 'Simulation speed' (accessible name did not contain the visible text), and the Vibe model picker showed 'Use model' but had aria-label 'AI model' - voice-control users could not operate either by its visible label
resolution: FIXED: dropped the sim-speed slider's overriding aria-label so the visible <label for=sim-speed>Sim speed</label> is the accessible name (kept aria-valuetext); the model picker aria-label is now 'Use model' to contain the visible span. Verified live: slider has the label + no mismatched aria-label. qa_honesty §23 pins both.

title: World/view selector labels were illegible (~1.05:1) on phones in the Light, Clean and Brick themes: .terrain-btn text is fixed light cream (--hud-fg-3) but the @640px rule repainted .view-panel .terrain-switch background to the theme's --navy-2 (near-white in light themes), breaking the documented 'fixed dark glass in EVERY theme' invariant that the select-chip fix (styles.css:717-722) had already restored once
resolution: FIXED: the @640px .view-panel .terrain-switch background is now the fixed dark glass rgba(8,9,15,0.85)+blur (not var(--navy-2)), so the light-cream labels stay readable in every theme on phones exactly as on desktop. Verified live: light theme @375px world-button contrast 17.48:1 (was 1.05:1). NEW qa_honesty §24 pins the @640 bar background. This exposed a qa_contrast §7 blind spot (it only modelled the desktop dark-glass assumption, never the @640 override).

title: REGRESSION from JR12-02: dropping the sim-speed slider's aria-label (to fix WCAG 2.5.3 Label-in-Name by relying on the visible <label>) left the slider with an EMPTY accessible name at <=768px, because .speed-ctrl label is display:none on mobile and a display:none <label> is removed from the accessibility tree (confirmed via CDP Accessibility.getPartialAXTree: name '' at 375px)
resolution: FIXED: the slider now has aria-label="Sim speed" - an EXACT match to the visible label, which satisfies both WCAG 2.5.3 (accessible name contains the visible text) AND survives the visible label being display:none at mobile widths (4.1.2/3.3.2). Verified live: aria-label 'Sim speed' present at 375px. qa_honesty §23 corrected: it now REQUIRES aria-label="Sim speed" (the earlier §23 wrongly asserted the ABSENCE of an aria-label, which is what caused this regression). Lesson: a Label-in-Name fix must preserve the name when the visible label can be hidden responsively.

title: pip wheel build failed: hatch double-added every web asset (packages=[src/robolearn] already includes assets/web, and a redundant force-include table re-mapped the same files)
resolution: FIXED: removed the redundant [tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include] table from pyproject.toml; the web assets are now included ONCE via packages + the artifacts glob. Verified: python -m build --wheel succeeds -> robolearn-2.0.0-py3-none-any.whl (4.28 MB, 83 web assets incl. bundle.js/interpreter.js/styles.css); pip install of the wheel imports cleanly with assets/web/bundle.js present. title: Skip-link target <main id="editor-main"> had no tabindex, so the WCAG 2.4.1 keyboard bypass could silently fail on Safari/VoiceOver (focus stays on the link; next Tab enters the ~15-control toolbar instead of the editor)
resolution: FIXED: added tabIndex={-1} to <main id="editor-main"> so the skip target reliably receives focus on every browser/AT. qa_honesty §27 pins it.

title: The Design Check (the deterministic layer marketed as authoritative) told catalogue builds to 'fit 4 DC motors for grip/torque' to fix low mobility, but after JR10-04 set all drive parts to speed 1.0, catalogue mobility=(speedFactor*traction)/massFactor took motor count ONLY as mass, so adding motors LOWERED the mobility score - counterproductive advice (refuter ran the modules: motors2 0.73 -> motors4 0.62 on ice). The torque benefit existed only in imported-spec physical mode
resolution: FIXED at the root: added a drive GRIP factor distinct from top speed (motors2 grip 1.0, motors4 1.4, servos 0.85). derive() now returns gripFactor; catalogue mobilityScore uses gripFactor (drive torque) not speedFactor, so more/stronger drive motors improve mobility, matching reality and the advice. Top speed stays count-independent (JR10-04 intact). BOTH the design check and the live tick read gripFactor, preserving their parity. Verified via the real assess(): motors4 now out-grips motors2 on every surface (ice 1.04 vs 0.75, sand 1.28 vs 0.92, city 2.27 vs 1.63). qa_interpreter 180 / grader
